label: travels or moves to
definition: Person, group or organization X travels, visits, arrives, returns or relocates to geographical place Y.
scope_notes: Preserves travel/relocation scope. Event participation, residence, death place, datelines and general association alone do not qualify; a relocation mentioned only as a potential move needs modal review.

facts.reason: Soviet Jews move/go/emigrate and are resettled in Israel.

WASHINGTON is a dateline-like subject linked to United States officials; neither path establishes travel.
Edwards dies in Sarasota; death location is not evidence of travel to it.
Yankees have a passive move-to-New-Jersey path but surrounding rows describe losing the team, attendance origins and designation for export; actuality of relocation is unresolved.
facts.reviewer_question: Does the original move-to sentence report an actual Yankees relocation, or a proposed/conditional move to New Jersey?
